M007.label: afflicted
M007.quote: Because of the strong martian and saturnine influences on the 8th 22nd Drekkana, Gandhi, an apostle of non-violence, had a ‘violent end.
M007.note: Shot dead by a fanatic in Sun Bhukti of Jupiter Dasa.

M015.label: none
M015.note: The Ramakrishna chapter says nothing about his father.

M023.label: mixed
M023.quote: This is an equally strong Rajayoga justifying his being the ruler of a premier Indian State ... the same Venus, who conferred power in his Bhukti in the Moon Dasa, deprived the Nizam of power and prestige
M023.note: He rose to rule a premier state, then was deprived of power and prestige; Raman also names Rajabhanga-like combinations.

M031.label: afflicted
M031.quote: The 7th house is equally afflicted; not in the sense of his not deriving happiness from his wives but in regard to loss of wives.
M031.note: He married three times and lost wives. Raman says the affliction is loss of wives, not unhappiness.

M039.label: favourable
M039.quote: Shaw's mother was a powerful factor in his life and the Moon's presence in Lagna accounts for this. The benefic disposition of Matrukaraka gave good longevity to his mother.

M047.label: none
M047.note: Raman only times the father's death ('In Saturn's sub-period his father died'). He gives no age and no judgment of the 9th house or the father.

M055.label: afflicted
M055.quote: The presence of the karaka Sun in the 9th is not at all desirable. ... The native was in her second year when her father died in Saturn Dasa, Jupiter Bhukti.

M063.label: afflicted
M063.quote: In Jupiter Dasa, Roosevelt's father died when he was eighteen.
M063.note: This is a reported event with a timing, not a judged verdict on the 9th. It counts as afflicted only if a father's death in the native's 18th year counts as early loss.

M071.label: favourable
M071.quote: Mercury as the intellectual planet is between the Sun and Mars revealing the native's political doctrines. His intellectual output in prison was prodiguous.
M071.note: Chart 114 is Nehru. The conclusion is about his intellectual or literary output, not a named learned profession.

M079.label: afflicted
M079.quote: and the 7th lord Jupiter in another dual sign resulted in two marriages. Married life was unhappy.

M087.label: afflicted
M087.quote: Putrakaraka Jupiter is afflicted. The 5th is a malefic sign and is occupied by a malefic planet. In the Navamsa again, the 5th from the Moon is highly afflicted. This explains his having only one daughter.
M087.note: Raman frames having only one child as an affliction of the 5th.

M095.label: favourable
M095.quote: This gives a great degree of mental control, good power of observation quick perception, and excellent faculties of reflection reasoning and analysis. ... The house of intelligence is well fortified.

M103.label: afflicted
M103.quote: All these made Nehru, a celebrated 'jail bird'.
M103.note: He was jailed repeatedly (Sun Dasa and Moon Dasa Mercury Bhukti).

M111.label: afflicted
M111.quote: The 8th house being aspected by Mars and lord of Lagna subjected to Papakarthari Yoga , coupled with the association of the Moon lord of the 8th with Ayushkaraka, did not give him good longevity.
M111.note: Raman calls it an 'untimely death in the prime of life' (line 8176) but says the end itself was peaceful because the 8th house is free from affliction.

M119.label: afflicted
M119.quote: The house of mother being afflicted considerably by Rahu indicates protection under a foster-mother during the period of Rahu.
M119.note: The native was raised by a foster-mother. Raman also cites Rahu and Saturn in the 4th as 'unhappiness throughout life'.

M127.label: mixed
M127.quote: the yogakaraka for Taurus Lagna in the 2nd enabled the native to earn considerable wealth but Saturn in the 2nd made him spend (of course on good purposes) all his earnings without saving anything.

M135.label: favourable
M135.quote: The native will have brothers. The third lord Saturn is in the 2nd Navamsha. The native will therefore have only two brothers (including himself).
M135.note: Siblings are promised but limited to one brother. Raman does not call it good or bad.

M143.label: favourable
M143.quote: The native, an heir to a large estate, being the son of a newspaper-magnate, and himself involved in it, his fortune too bloomed in the country of his birth.

M151.label: afflicted
M151.quote: In spite of the wealth and the great qualities of head and heart he possessed, the Maharaja was not happy so far as marriage life was concerned.

M159.label: afflicted
M159.quote: Only one daughter was horn just at the beginning of Ketu Dasha and she is living. That apart the native has had no issues.
M159.note: Raman says the 5th is 'adversely affected' but 'birth of children is not denied'. One daughter survives. A two-sided reading (mixed) is arguable.

M167.label: mixed
M167.quote: The 5th lord Jupiter is doubtless well placed but the 5th is considerably afflicted ... He had five children but was not very happy especially because the character of his eldest son filled him with gloomy anticipation.

M175.label: afflicted
M175.quote: The chart is more significant for the prison-terms the native underwent during the Indian Independence days. ... The presence of the 8th lord and the 12th lord in a kendra has resulted in a Bandhana Yoga.
M175.note: Chart 247 is Gandhi, arrested several times.

M183.label: favourable
M183.quote: The native was a big industrialist and was one of the wealthiest Indians.
M183.note: Raman also cites combinations denoting 'immense wealth'.

M191.label: mixed
M191.quote: Since the 9th lord is afflicted together with the Sun, the father cannot live very long. But the position of the 9th lord ina kendra in a beneficial constellation cannot deprive the native of her father very early in life either.
M191.note: Her father died in January 1973, when she was about 23.

M199.label: afflicted
M199.quote: The native has only one daughter. Mark, while the 5th house is fairly well disposed, the 5th lord Saturn and PutraKaraka are both considerably afflicted
M199.note: Raman also notes some miscarriages and premature births.

M207.label: favourable
M207.quote: The Nizam is noted for his fabulous wealth ... The very presence of Venus in the 5th accounts for his owning immense wealth.

M215.label: mixed
M215.quote: The native will have a fair complexion, middle-sized stature and handsome appearance. He becomes a keen observer of human nature. ... the native suffered seriously from typhoid and malarial fevers.
M215.note: Mostly a physical and character description, plus serious fevers in infancy and 'emotional upsets'. Raman gives no single overall verdict.

M223.label: afflicted
M223.quote: The 7th lord afflicted by Rahu and Mars gave a disgusting husband who was at once stupid and stubborn.
M223.note: She was also widowed in Saturn Dasa (Chart 24, Marie Antoinette).

M231.label: favourable
M231.quote: This combination brought him good reputation and wide influence and made him an authority not only in astrology but in the Indian sciences and history as well.

M239.label: favourable
M239.quote: Sri Thyagaraja is a household name in South India and he occupies a pre-eminent place amongst the great masters of South Indian music.
M239.note: He was indifferent to worldly affluence. The verdict is about his attainment as a musician and saint.

M247.label: favourable
M247.quote: Lagna lord, subject to neechabhanga in the 10th by Venus, who in his turn has caused Malavya Yoga, clearly reveals that Einstein was undoubtedly one of the greatest mankind has ever produced.
M247.note: Raman's summing-up of the native. Health and body are covered only briefly ('slender frame').

M255.label: afflicted
M255.quote: The native has plenty of trouble with the arms and limbs. ... Her real troubles started in Saturn Dasha, Rahu Bhukti. There was gradual loss of the limbs, which left her prostrate.
M255.note: Paralysis of the limbs and arms.

M263.label: mixed
M263.quote: A man of independent thinking. Self-made, he has risen to a very high position in life after much struggle. ... The Moon being hemmed in between Mars and Saturn makes the mind worried almost always.
M263.note: He rose to a high position, but Raman also says the mind is worried, wavering and pessimistic. 'Favourable' is defensible if the matter is read as status.

M271.label: mixed
M271.quote: The house of gains being extremely strongly disposed, the native inherited a royal throne ... the gains acquried during Saturn's Dasa could not last long and the native had to abdicate the throne

M279.label: none
M279.note: The 4th is discussed only as the house of education. Raman draws no conclusion about Sivananda's mother.

M287.label: favourable
M287.quote: The afflictions result in temperamental clashes but the presence of Saturn in the 7th and Jupiter and Venus in mutual aspect result in a stable marriage with deep attachment between the couple.
M287.note: The cited passage (Chart 210) covers elder siblings only. The same native is HTJAH-II Chart No. 1 (line 1009), where Raman judges the marriage. It is two-sided but leans favourable; see also line 2686.

M295.label: mixed
M295.quote: These yogas enabled the native to emerge as a powerful industrialist during Mercury's Dasa ... As soon as Ketu Dasa began, the native's financial empire came crashing down.

M303.label: afflicted
M303.quote: Since the first house planet is a malefic and since he is in conjunction With the Moon, the native will not be quite healthy.
M303.note: Raman adds that this disposition confers a weak constitution.

M311.label: favourable
M311.quote: His poetic greatness is due to the position of Venus in the 2nd and Gemini a sign of fertility and creation rising in the 2nd house.
M311.note: The conclusion is about poetic expression credited to the 2nd house, not speech as such.

M319.label: afflicted
M319.quote: Enormous losses and enormous troubles for the native of the above horoscope coincided with the commencement of Rahu Dasha. ... The man is involved in huge debts.
